name: DtlWatchState
meaning: DaffyTrainingLevel.watchState (+0x7e), SetMode arg 1: the Watch challenge

name: DTL_WATCH_OFF
meaning: case 0: waits for the Wolf in startBox

name: DTL_WATCH_READY
meaning: case 1: Wolf in the start box; leaving it starts the Watch (msgs 0x3781/0x3782)

name: DTL_WATCH_FAILED
meaning: case 3: kills the Wolf (msg 0 arg 3) after deathDelay
